descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Dezvoltare de software și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
We are looking for an experienced Business Intelligence & Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in IBM Cognos Analytics, Talend ETL, and Oracle database technologies to build scalable data warehouses, optimize reports, and support data-driven decision-making across the organization.
 What You’ll Do 
Design, build, and optimize complex BI reports and metadata models using IBM Cognos Analytics (Reporting, Framework Manager, Transformer).
Develop, deploy, and maintain data integration pipelines using Talend ETL .
Write, debug, and tune high-performance Oracle SQL queries and PL/SQL packages/procedures.
Implement and refine data warehouse structures using star and snowflake schema modeling techniques.
Partner with cross-functional international teams to translate business requirements into technical data solutions.
 What We’re Looking For 
 Experience: Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, or Software Development.
 Core BI Expertise: Strong background in IBM Cognos Analytics (Reporting, Framework Manager, and Transformer).
 ETL & Data Integration: Practical, hands-on experience with Talend ETL .
 Database & SQL: Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL .
 Data Architecture: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas).
 Languages: Fluent English and French are mandatory. 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, or a related field.
 Nice-to-Haves 
Proficiency or working knowledge of Romanian is a strong advantage.
